title: Civic Tech
description: Nepal has a small but high-quality civic-tech scene. YoungInnovations builds international transparency platforms (AidStream, ResourceContracts). Code for Nepal, Open Knowledge Nepal, Kathmandu Living Labs, and Accountability Lab Nepal lead the space.
